0022600108.text: The Wizards (1-1, second in the Southeast and fifth in the East, coming off a loss) visit the Bulls (1-1, second in the Central and seventh in the East, coming off a win) for Washington's third game of the season. Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Chicago is without Nic Claxton (hamstring). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Washington lost all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 119-108 defeat in Washington on April 9, 2026.
